messages:
Ibrahim: deploy-bot triggered an auto-rollback on text-gen-v2 due to eval regression (semantic drift in safety eval). Automation paused because a customer (acct: acme-corp) has a pinned dedicated deployment on v2. Need quick call: full hosted revert + support ticket for dedicated customer consent, or try a hosted-only revert and route pinned traffic to fallback?

deploy-bot: :warning: AUTO-ROLLBACK: model=text-gen-v2; reason=eval-safety-regression; trigger=monotonic-eval-fail(3). Auto-rollback suppressed for pinned customers. Suggested actions: 1) revert hosted traffic to text-gen-v1.11, 2) open dedicated custody ticket for acme-corp, 3) apply temporary server-side filter for specific prompt patterns. Runbook: https://runbook.internal/rollback-models

Lena: If we do hosted revert we should also pin an alias so customers don't oscillate when we roll forward. Suggest creating alias text-gen-stable->v1.11.

Priya: We can do hosted-only revert by changing the routing policy: `rclient routing set --scope hosted --model text-gen-v1.11`. That won't touch dedicated deployments.

QA-bot: TESTS: safety-regression reproduced on canary at 02:14 UTC. Failing prompt groups: PG-7 and PG-9. Confidence=0.93. Repro commands and logs: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"<PG-7-sample>"}'``` Response contains flagged tokens.

Ibrahim: Good. Priya + Lena proceed with hosted-only revert. Jordan please open RL ticket and notify support to contact acme-corp for dedicated consent.

Jordan: Opening RL-174321 now. Assigning to Jordan, tagging SRE and Account Manager. Support-Bot will create support ticket ST-56321 to acme-corp.

Support-Bot: Support ticket ST-56321 created and assigned to @Priya-AM. Template sent to customer: "We've detected a model quality regression and propose a failover plan. Please confirm if you want us to revert your dedicated instance to v1.11 or accept a temporary mitigation."

Priya: Executing hosted routing change now -> `rclient routing set --scope hosted --route text-gen --model text-gen-v1.11 --alias text-gen-stable`

deploy-bot: ACTION: hosted routing updated by priya (user). New hosted default=model text-gen-v1.11; alias text-gen-stable -> v1.11. Event emitted to #deploy-notifications.

Lena: Can we also add a short-lived filter to drop known-malformed prompts? Might reduce blast radius while we talk to acme-corp.

Ibrahim: yes, apply prompt-filter stage flag `--filter pg7,pg9` via edge config. Priya can coordinate with infra to deploy filter for hosted only.

Priya: edge filter deployed for hosted scope. Command: `edgectl filters apply --scope hosted --id temp-pg-filter --patterns PG-7,PG-9`

Jordan: RL-174321: linked telemetry: https://telemetry.internal/redwood/rl/1743219876. Support ticket ST-56321 created. ACME response pending; AM will escalate if no reply in 1 hour.

Ibrahim: Next: release notes and internal comms. Jordan can you draft the internal incident blurb? Lena, can you prepare the public-facing release note (short non-technical) in #release-notes-drafts?

Jordan: Drafting internal blurb: "Hosted runtime rolled back to text-gen-v1.11 due to safety eval regression observed in v2. Dedicated pinned deployments unaffected pending customer consent. Support team notified acme-corp." Posting in #incident-internal once approved.

Lena: Draft for release-notes-drafts: "We've temporarily reverted hosted model to v1.11 after detecting a regression in a limited set of prompts. No action required for dedicated customers unless contacted by Support." Posting now. :white_check_mark:

QA-bot: Additional check: rerun PG-7/9 against hosted -> PASS with v1.11. Failure rate drops to baseline.

Ibrahim: OK. Summary: (1) Hosted traffic reverted to v1.11 (done), alias created, (2) Temporary prompt filter applied to hosted, (3) RL-174321 + ST-56321 opened for dedicated customer consent, (4) Release notes drafted. Assignments: Jordan (incident blurb & ticket owner), Priya (routing + filter ops), Lena (release note draft), Support-AM (customer outreach). Reopen thread if ACME requests revert for their dedicated instance or if telemetry shows further regression.

deploy-bot: SUMMARY: hosted revert executed; automation suppressed for pinned/dedicated customers. Manual follow-ups required for dedicated instances.

Priya: ack, monitoring hosted metrics and will revert alias to v2 once QA signs off and Support confirms customer OK.
